style_block: Original digital hand-drawn 2D wasteland combat-game art. Wear belongs on every manufactured surface: dents, rust bloom, chipped paint, soot and dirt in seams; no factory-new finish. Shared material palette: soot black, sun-baked ochre, rust orange, dried-blood red and bleached bone; one toxic hazard-yellow accent. Detail clusters at silhouette anchors, never uniform noise. Neutral flat even diffuse light, symmetric material shading, no directional illumination and no baked cast shadow. Weathered screen-print illustration in exactly six inks: soot black, bleached bone, sun-baked ochre, rust orange, dried-blood red and hazard yellow. Contours are carved negative-space wedges rather than drawn outlines. Hard flat cut shapes, sparse large halftone clusters, deliberately offset ink-edge slivers. Stout emblem-like proportions, very low detail density, stark sun-bleached propaganda mood.
camera: True orthographic top-down: camera directly above, roof planes only, no visible front or side body faces. Cars point right, toward screen +x.
negative: No franchise references, existing fictional characters or copied vehicles, brands, logos, text, letters, numbers, watermark, clean primaries, factory-new surfaces, photorealism, 3D render, perspective, cast shadows or cropped subject. No occupants inside vehicles. No decorative ground behind isolated subjects.
name: Bleached Poster
rationale: Graphic economy and pale heat; must remain a vehicle rather than an emblem.
